text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Geez, why, why, why, why?! I'm not hitting the target at all~~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Zero targets hit—it seems varying your strength with every throw is throwing off your control.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I'm sure you'll figure that out as you go,
won't you? Keep practicing without getting discouraged—"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
B-But it's no fun if I don't hit anything!!
I wanna practice in a way that's way more fun!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see. Indeed, one cannot expect good results
from practicing without any enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Well then, how about something like this?
We can actively incorporate things that Turbo likes
into her practice—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: *gasp* *pant*, 10 pitches...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Turbo.
Here's some candy as a reward.
Let's do our best on the next 10 pitches too!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Uuuuugh, Turbo is totally full now...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If she snacks too much, she won't have room for dinner.
Maybe you should keep the reward candy strategy in moderation?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ei, yah!
Yaaay, perfect!!
Turbo's amazing! Turbo did great!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? But when you actually throw it,
you can't tap or swipe, right?
Huuuh???

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, then I'll stop playing games and watch training videos!!
This one, that one, that other one, I'll watch aaaall of them!!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, is 8x speed
even sinking into your brain!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We haven't gotten any major results so far...
However, this will serve as the driving force for our next plan.
Now then, what else could Turbo get engrossed in—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, Turbo really does love running best of all!
It feels so good when you go whoosh and zoom!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Running... is it? Indeed, Turbo-san
always seems to be having so much fun running at full power.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"This might actually work.
Turbo-san, let's give it a try.
Full-speed dash into a full-power pitch...!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh, I can run?
Then Turbo's gonna run! Here I gooooo!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: UWOOOOOOAAAAHHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: —*gasp*, *pant*, *wheeze*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now's your chance, Turbo-san!
Keep your aim right on the target—
(Wobble-wobble-wobble... *CLACK*!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... Y-Yes...!
Turbo hit the target... Turbo hit it... Did ya see...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes, I was watching! The power of your "passion" really is wonderful, Turbo-san!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*... Wonderful...
Love is... so wonderful...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Rather than the power of 'love,' I feel like it was just because I shook off all that unnecessary tension, but—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, with pitches still left to throw,
I wonder if this kid's stamina will hold out until the end...
